description:
My Property Box are delighted to present this stunning HouseShare located in South Shields, NE33. This property is available for rent and boasts a range of impressive features.

The property offers six spacious bedrooms with en-suites and one modern bathroom, along with a large shared kitchen that has been recently refurbished and modernised throughout.

The property is ideally located close to metro links, providing easy access to the wider area. In addition, street parking is available for those with a vehicle. Each room also comes with its own desk, making it ideal for students or professionals who need to work from home.

Overall, this HouseShare property is perfect for those looking for a modern and comfortable living space, with all the amenities required for a convenient lifestyle. Contact us today to arrange a viewing 0191 212 0400.
